lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder) proved helpful (+3.0% average after noise correction), winning 3 tests, while 3 showed no clear effect and 1 was stopped early.
Home redesigns (home, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.3% average after noise correction).
Choose path redesigns (choose_path, redesign) were helpful (+2.9% average after noise correction), winning 1 test while 1 showed no clear effect.
Adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow) showed mixed results (+0.9% average after noise correction), winning 1 test, showing no clear effect in 1, and performing poorly in 1.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
Predictions were generally too low for winning tests and too high for tests showing no clear effect or performing poorly.

candidates.title: Interactive compact layout for home welcome step
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen using a compact layout with an interactive control preview component.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with long median/mean duration (395s/5815s) and users write support emails about post-onboarding desktop controls confusion.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen! Click to pet, drag to move, or right-click for quick controls.

guard.reason: Redesign of home_intro screen within onboarding complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has highest drop-off and support complaints, but major UI redesigns have consistently shown poor results.

candidates.title: Desktop setup guidance on waiting screen
candidates.change: Add visible progress status and desktop visibility instructions to the pet generation waiting screen.
candidates.why: Users wait a median of 201s during pet generation and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop after waiting.

waiting.hint: Your pet will automatically pop up on your desktop when ready. Keep this window open during setup.

guard.reason: Adding progress and setup guidance to the waiting screen retains its required job and complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high waiting duration and support emails with informative status guidance.

candidates.title: List layout sign-in screen redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen into a structured list layout clearly distinguishing existing account login from guest registration.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in with wrong or duplicate accounts.

sign_in.headline: Sign in to save your desktop pet
sign_in.body: Connect your account to sync your pet settings and prevent pet resets on reinstall.
sign_in.hint: Returning user? Sign in with your previous login method to restore your active pets.

guard.reason: Redesigning the sign-in screen into a list layout retains its job and keeps all onboarding steps intact.

candidates.score_note: Strong support email backing, but previous sign_in redesign had a slightly negative impact.

candidates.title: Pre-adoption custom photo verification screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated photo check screen before upload to verify lighting and pet photo resolution.
candidates.why: Custom pet generation fails or generates wrong visuals for several users (3 support tickets), contributing to the 75.2% adoption conversion.

upload_photos.hint: Use a clear, front-facing pet photo with good lighting for best custom generation.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_photo_check']

candidates.title: Two-column layout for pick friend screen
candidates.change: Rebuild the pick_friend screen with a two-column layout comparing preset pets next to custom photo creation options.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion (75.2%) and long mean time (1017s); side-by-side choices help users decide faster.

pick_friend.headline: Select Your Desktop Friend
pick_friend.body: Choose a classic preset buddy or generate a custom companion from your photos.

guard.reason: Two-column layout redesign for picking a friend retains the screen's core job and keeps pricing intact.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off, but prior adoption redesign test resulted in -8.1% lift.

candidates.title: Story intro path selection flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive story introduction screen before choose_path to guide user expectations before path selection.
candidates.why: Choose path redesigns have proven effective (+2.9% win rate), but mean time spent on choose_path remains high at 514s.

choose_path.headline: Which pet experience do you want?
choose_path.body: Pick a quick ready-made desktop pet or upload photos to craft your custom companion.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_path_intro']

candidates.title: Adoption certificate memory guarantee callout
candidates.change: Add a prominent permanent memory badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Users fear losing pet data (8 support emails), and adding account persistence assurance during certificate creation increases confidence.

adoption_certificate.hint: Your adoption certificate registers your pet's permanent ID to your device.

guard.reason: Replacing adoption certificate components with a permanent ID badge removes the required official stamp.

candidates.title: Desktop tray and hotkey control hint
candidates.change: Display explicit hotkey and system tray control hints on the home_intro screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet after finishing onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Control your pet anytime by right-clicking it on your desktop or clicking its system tray icon.

guard.reason: Adding hotkey and tray control hints to home_intro is allowed and preserves all existing functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targets lowest converting finish step with hints to resolve reported post-onboarding confusion.

candidates.title: Clear path comparison copy on story screen
candidates.change: Update story screen headline and body text to set distinct expectations between instant pet selection and photo generation.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a 80.6% drop-off step conversion and high mean duration (514s) due to unclear choice expectations.

story.headline: Welcome to Desktop Pets
story.body: Choose a pre-made friend to launch instantly, or create a personalized pet from your photos.

guard.reason: Updating story screen copy still fulfills the job of introducing the pet without touching pricing or structure.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak targeting choose_path where previous path changes averaged +2.9% lift.

candidates.title: Ready notification trigger on waiting step
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app during pet generation.
candidates.why: Generation waiting time has high mean duration (2336s), causing users to close or abandon the app while waiting.

waiting.hint: Feel free to minimize this app. We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Enabling desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen preserves the waiting screen's job and complies with fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Notification trigger mitigates user drop-off during the long home step wait time.
